Pixel Space End-to-End Learning Hierarchy

The same particles form three isolated modules with the words 2 Stage in the middle. The middle module and its words become the hand from the source GIF. The hand starts at finger contact and plays the snap. The hand, encoder, and decoder then change together into one connected particle ribbon. The words End-to-End move with the ribbon. The same particles then form HiT.
